Apple Music officially launched a brand new brand design, including new design, logo and more. And in a video introducing this brand refresh, Apple revealed that this new look is actually "built from sound".

Apple Music officially launches brand refresh, reveals behind-the-scenes process of new logo

Over the past few weeks there have been signs that Apple Music is about to undergo a major brand refresh, including the appearance of a brand new app icon and other design updates in iOS 27.2.

Now Apple has finally officially unveiled the new look, saying the design is "built from sound".

From the official Apple Music account on X:

Just like the Apple TV brand refresh back then, Apple this time also released a behind-the-scenes video explaining how the new logo was actually created. And as Apple's music streaming service, the new Apple Music look is naturally "built from sound". Apple says:

A story about music, collaboration and craftsmanship, presented by Fred again.. and NEST Acoustics. Learn how sound brings the Apple Music logo to life, all shot on location. Make music, visible.

JP's hot comment

A refreshing change, no doubt. Looking for that reddish icon with a hint of pink on my device and in the app switcher has become a deeply ingrained habit of mine. This new icon blends in with the icons of TV App, HBO Max App and many other apps, so it might take some time to get used to. I love Apple Music. My biggest complaint right now is that Siri AI performs terribly in searching for the media content I want to listen to. I asked it to play "Day Tripper (Songwriting Work Tape)", which is included on the new "Rubber Soul (Super Deluxe)", but Siri played the ordinary version of "Day Tripper" from "The Beatles Yesterday and Today" instead.

Below is the behind-the-scenes video of the Apple Music brand refresh:

Users will see the brand new Apple Music brand image when iOS 27.2 launches next week.

What do you think of Apple Music's brand new look? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.

Apple Music monthly fee is $11.99 USD, and is also available through an Apple One bundle subscription.
